capabilities: Generate OpenAI embeddings for the current note or batches of notes matched by filename patterns
Semantic-search notes similar to the active note via a command or sidebar
Suggest note improvements (titles, links, tags, splitting) with the copilot sidebar view
Skip re-embedding notes whose content has not changed
disambiguation: Not a full Zettelkasten workflow plugin; it only adds embedding-based semantic search and a copilot that suggests revisions.
extras: The README requires setting an OpenAI API key (and an Anthropic API key) in the plugin settings before use, meaning requests cost money; it also includes manual developer installation steps and mentions the folder name obsidian-gpt-zettelkasten from an earlier identity.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search matches exact text, so it cannot find notes that are semantically similar to the one you are reading.
summary: LLM-powered Zettelkasten toolkit that creates embeddings for notes to enable semantic search and offers a copilot that suggests note improvements.
